mapper.sql: FROM t_payment_route_record prr LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order latest_pr ON latest_pr.id = ( SELECT pr.id FROM t_prepay_order pr WHERE pr.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_pa ON latest_pa.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) AND ( (pa.attempt_no = prr.attempt_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.attempt_no) AND CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.attempt_no AS BINARY(256))) OR (prr.attempt_no IS NULL AND pa.created_at <= prr.created_at) ) ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

if.test: query.paymentMethod != null and query.paymentMethod != '' and query.paymentMethod != '全部'
query.terminal != null and query.terminal != '' and query.terminal != '全部'

mapper.sql: (SELECT FROM t_payment_order p WHERE p.payment_order_id = po.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) AND CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1) AS successFactIssue
mapper.select:
SELECT prr.route_no AS routeNo, prr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, latest_pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, po.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(po.amount, 2)) AS amount, latest_pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, prr.channel_code AS channelCode, prr.route_rule AS routeRule, prr.route_result AS routeResult, prr.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%兜底%' THEN 'warn' WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 'info' ELSE 'success' END AS routeResultType, latest_pa.terminal AS terminal, latest_pa.client_ip AS clientIp, latest_pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, latest_pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, latest_pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
ORDER BY prr.channel_code
ORDER BY prr.route_result
ORDER BY prr.created_at
ASC, prr.id ASC
DESC, prr.id DESC
LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT prr.route_no AS routeNo, prr.attempt_no AS requestNo, prr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, exact_pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, po.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(po.amount, 2)) AS amount, exact_pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, prr.channel_code AS channelCode, prr.route_rule AS routeRule, prr.route_result AS routeResult, prr.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%兜底%' THEN 'warn' WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 'info' ELSE 'success' END AS routeResultType, exact_pa.terminal AS terminal, exact_pa.client_ip AS clientIp, exact_pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, exact_pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, exact_pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
FROM t_payment_route_record prr LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt exact_pa ON exact_pa.attempt_no = prr.attempt_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pa.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.attempt_no) AND CAST(exact_pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) AND exact_pa.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pa.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(exact_pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order exact_pr ON exact_pr.prepay_order_no = exact_pa.prepay_order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pr.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pa.prepay_order_no) AND CAST(exact_pr.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(exact_pa.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND exact_pr.payment_order_id = exact_pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(exact_pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(exact_pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(exact_pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) WHERE prr.route_no = #{routeNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(prr.route_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{routeNo}) AND CAST(prr.route_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{routeNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT prr.route_no AS routeNo, prr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, latest_pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, po.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(po.amount, 2)) AS amount, latest_pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, prr.channel_code AS channelCode, prr.route_rule AS routeRule, prr.route_result AS routeResult, prr.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%兜底%' THEN 'warn' WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 'info' ELSE 'success' END AS routeResultType, latest_pa.terminal AS terminal, latest_pa.client_ip AS clientIp, latest_pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, latest_pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, latest_pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
ORDER BY prr.channel_code
ORDER BY prr.route_result
ORDER BY prr.created_at
ASC, prr.id ASC
DESC, prr.id DESC
LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalRouteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%兜底%' THEN 0 WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS successRouteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%兜底%' THEN 1 WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warnRouteCount, COUNT(DISTINCT prr.channel_code) AS distinctChannelCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prr.route_result LIKE '%线下%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offlineRouteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN latest_pa.payment_method = '微信' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wechatRouteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN latest_pa.payment_method = '支付宝' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS alipayRouteCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(prr.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestRouteAt
